verdict.rationale: Forter is a SaaS fraud-prevention platform that ingests customer and order data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training data use or any opt-out control. PCI tokenization and hosted secure iframes are adjacent data-security features and do not address model-training consent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
